description: Estimated market value (loose, CIB, and new) for a game or console from NOSTOS's own pricing engine, built on live market data and recent sold listings, plus the NOSTOS cash and store-credit buy offers.

condition.description: Optional condition to focus the result on. 'boxgame' is Box & Game (No Manual).

name.description: Title to look up, e.g. 'Mario Kart 64'.
